title: Understanding — Exchange — payload
description: A joining party answers a host's comprehension questions about the terms named in an understanding/offer response; the host records whether the answers demonstrate understanding. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

offerId.description: The `id` of the understanding/offer response this exchange answers against, naming which terms version the answers are about.

offerDigestMultibase.description: OPTIONAL. The task digest of the understanding/offer response named by `offerId`, computed per SPEC §4.9.3 as multibase(multihash(H(JCS(document ∖ proof)))) over that response in full. Pairs the id with the exact document the joining party answered against, so the offer -> exchange -> seal chain can be digest-bound end to end where each link carries its digest. When present, the host MUST recompute it from its own record of the offer response as issued and refuse a mismatch, or an unsupported hash algorithm, with understanding/exchange:offerDigestMismatch.

answers.description: The joining party's answers to the host's comprehension questions, in the order the host posed them or any order the host's own question format tolerates.

questionId.description: Identifies which of the host's comprehension questions this answers. Defined by the host's terms document, out of band; opaque to this specification.

answer.description: The joining party's answer. Its accepted values and format are defined by the host's terms document, out of band.

Response.title: Understanding — Exchange — response payload
Response.description: The host's determination of whether the answers demonstrate understanding, bound by taskContext and taskDigestMultibase per SPEC §4.9.3 and §7.3 item 20.5's first binding form, so this response can serve as this specification's declared outcome evidence (see spec.md front matter, outcomeEvidence). Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape; outcome: insufficient is a normal determination, not a failure.

taskContext.description: The `id` of the understanding/exchange request this response determines — the initiating document of this exchange per SPEC §4.9.1.

taskDigestMultibase.description: The task digest of the request named by `taskContext`, computed per SPEC §4.9.3 as multibase(multihash(H(JCS(document ∖ proof)))) over the FULL request document — so the binding also covers `offerId`, the answers, and `offerDigestMultibase` where present.

score.description: An OPTIONAL, host-defined score. Opaque to this specification — neither its scale nor its passing threshold is standardized.
